plugins.name: parallel-dev-plugin
plugins.description: English version of plan-parallel-dev-plugin. Skill for creating parallel development plans with multiple developers using git worktree, dependency analysis, critical path calculation, and timeline creation.

plugins.name: project-intent-plugin
plugins.description: Project intent management skill that structures project goals and policies in JSON format. Optimizes context sharing with AI agents through .intent/project.json (project constitution) and .intent/brief.json (worktree thinking memos). Use when you want to set up project intent, create project.json, or manage brief.json.
